## Trigger

When consumers use the published harness, I want the approved integrity, comments, permission, installation, verification and checkpoint fixes released, so I can trust the existing operations.

## Scope

- `CHANGELOG.md`
- `changelog.d/*.md`
- `src/basicly/__init__.py`
- `src/basicly/release_history.json`
- `src/basicly/shipped_core.json`
- `.basicly/core/kit/tracker/pin.py`

- `AGENTS.md`

- `.agents/skills/**`
- `.github/agents/**`

## Release Plan

Required records in order: basicly-jho04rg, basicly-gcs3bu1, basicly-5rx5pn9, basicly-ejowvgn, basicly-49vecmn, basicly-6ip8ao9, basicly-1ys9rth, basicly-zq9i2m.1. Assess basicly-k6tpep.3 and basicly-0j2ubwq for this release. Preserve existing record ownership and parent relationships. Main session orchestrates isolated specialist worktrees and integrates in priority order. Complete current reproductions, smallest root-cause fixes, regressions, changelog fragments, standalone package validation, full integrated gates, release trial, publication and fresh consumer installation. Record deferrals and adjacent repairs. Preserve the source checkout user configuration edit byte for byte. No tracker redesign or broad caching work.


## Final Scope

Both assessed optional fixes were included. Approved Codex defaults and necessary generation, projection, typed-copy scrub and CI prerequisite repairs are integrated. The release retains explicit acknowledged historical sequence loss with unknown original content. Existing layout clipping basicly-c9crxu and source-revision module loading basicly-h3jzio6 remain separate followups. Complete full integrated checks, published-history trial clone, recorded tutorial walk, native release, publication evidence, downloaded-asset consumer proof, clean original checkout and handover.
